items.titleEn: Environmental Protection Agency in Kylon reinforces inspections of waste removal, pulls cars and practices to prevent illegal dumping
items.summaryEn: In order to prevent unlawful traffickers from using their vehicles to transport waste, to try to avoid inspections and checks on documentation, the Environmental Protection Agency of the city of Keulen recently organized a "Working Exercise on the Tracking of Vehicles for the Carriage of Waste", to simulate the on-site handling of cases of illegal transportation, to actually inspect standard work processes such as vehicle tracking, duty-free storage and relocation, to strengthen the ability of law enforcement personnel to apply and to ensure the legal completeness of the enforcement process. items.title: 雙11物流配送量暴增！新北勞檢處籲業者防範司機過勞
items.summary: 雙11購物節即將到來，各大電商平台陸續推出促銷優惠，預期將帶動網購及物流配送需求大幅增加。為避免貨運司機及物流人員因短時間內工作量暴增，出現超時工作或過勞情形，新北市勞檢處呼籲物流業者及貨運公司，應妥善調配人力與配送時程，確實遵守《勞動基準法》工時規定，保障勞工工作權益及身心健康。 《詳全文...》
items.titleEn: The number of logistics deliveries has increased! Northern Labor Prosecutor's Office urges employers to prevent overworking drivers
items.summaryEn: The upcoming Double 11 Shopping Festival, where major e-commerce platforms are continuing to launch promotional offers, is expected to drive a significant increase in demand for online shopping and logistics delivery. In order to avoid overtime or overtime work due to a short-term increase in the workload of freight drivers and logistics personnel, the Department of Labor of the City of Nottingham urges logistics operators and transport companies to properly coordinate manpower and delivery schedules, strictly adhere to the labour standards law, and safeguard workers' rights and physical and mental health.
